notes: Two-tier printed header flattened with / : "Settling velocity m/s," and "Surface Overflow rate m³ / d /m²" each carry the printed second-level heading "Ss = 2.65", and "Diameter of Particles, mm" spans both header tiers.

The prose on this page states that Table 5.6 gives settling velocity of different size particles of specific gravity 2.65 and the corresponding surface overflow rates for 100% removal based on Equation (5.8).
